q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a railway station?
title: Railway station carbon footprint
short: Most of it is electricity for lighting, fans, lifts, escalators, waiting room AC and signage: kWh times 0.710 kg CO2. Add diesel for backup generators. Shops and food stalls on separate meters belong to their operators unless the railway pays their power.
audience: Railway station managers and concession operators

ul: Concessions: stalls, retiring rooms, parcel offices.
Traction power is not station power; keep it out.

p: Divide station kWh by footfall for a comparable figure across stations and months.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
